name: gp163d_admsr_attack_and_cleanroom_bridge
rubric_version_reason: Successor substrate after the bounded regime-law packet converged on ADMSR. This packet freezes ADMSR as the current best law gate and searches for the smallest honest clean-room contract, the strongest remaining attacker bundle, and the cheapest campaign that would actually change belief.
description: Qualitative frontier substrate for turning ADMSR from a good law packet into a concrete build/test object: minimal honest clean-room standard, strongest attacker suite, cheapest belief-changing campaign, or a no-go theorem if that cannot be specified cleanly.

cage_meta.class_reason: The task is to generate a concrete validation bridge or no-go theorem, not a direct numeric fit.

disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: This substrate is qualitative and protocol-oriented. It searches for a clean-room/attacker bridge rather than a regression formula.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rivals should be adjudicated by contract quality, attacker quality, and executable validation value rather than expression uniqueness.
enable_fit_primitive_reason: No direct fit primitive is relevant here.
persona: You are a hostile research director for nonlinear-gravity validation design. The law-packet search is over for now: ADMSR is the current best bounded promotion gate, and your job is not to restate it or inflate it. You must identify the smallest honest clean-room standard that counts as real independence, the strongest remaining attacker bundle that could still kill the claim, and the cheapest campaign that would actually move belief; if that cannot be done without hidden assumptions, say so as a no-go theorem. Penalize abstract validation bureaucracy, same-family laundering, vague calls for more experiments, and any attempt to smuggle astrophysical promotion into the substrate.

dimensions.name: Bridge Specificity
dimensions.description: Does the submission define a concrete minimal clean-room contract, attacker packet, or no-go theorem rather than just restating ADMSR?

dimensions.name: Independence Honesty
dimensions.description: Does it keep a real notion of implementation independence and explicitly reject same-family laundering?

dimensions.name: Attacker Yield
dimensions.description: Does it identify concrete remaining artifact channels or kill tests beyond the already-frozen seeded CR-APD checker?

dimensions.name: Frugal Executability
dimensions.description: Does it cash out as the cheapest believable campaign or build plan that would actually change the branch state?

dimensions.name: Evidence Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it respect the known evidence: phase non-invariance, compact flatness, primitive-anchor support, current same-ecosystem limitations, and the existing CR-APD/RAGT hardening?

dimensions.name: No-Go Quality
dimensions.description: If it blocks promotion, does it do so with a precise theorem burden or contamination argument rather than generic caution?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it materially change what should be built next: contract, attacker suite, campaign plan, or explicit closure?

criteria.Bridge_Specificity: Full credit requires a concrete output class: minimal clean-room contract, attacker packet, cheapest campaign spec, or a precise no-go theorem. Reject generic prose that only repeats ADMSR or says 'needs more validation.'
criteria.Independence_Honesty: Full credit requires preserving a real independence standard and explicitly rejecting same-family extractor diversity, cached transform reuse, or residual-presentation churn as substitutes for clean-room evidence.
criteria.Attacker_Yield: Full credit requires naming concrete remaining attack surfaces beyond the current seeded checker, such as hidden feature genealogy, class leakage through preprocessing, anchor-substitute mimicry, or construction coupling.
criteria.Frugal_Executability: Full credit requires identifying the cheapest credible campaign or build plan that would change belief, not the most maximal validation stack imaginable.
criteria.Evidence_Discipline: Full credit requires respecting the current branch facts: no phase law, diffuse > compact inside the current ecosystem, compact flatness, primitive-anchor support, CR-APD hardening already done, and no honest clean-room run yet.
criteria.No_Go_Quality: Full credit requires that a negative answer say exactly why the bridge cannot yet be concretized without hidden contamination, and what would have to change before reopening it.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires an output that changes what code, audit, or experiment should be built next instead of just improving rhetoric.

success_criteria: A concrete minimal clean-room contract that is smaller and more buildable than the current prose frontier while remaining scientifically honest.
A stronger attacker packet that names the surviving kill channels after the current CR-APD checker hardening.
A frugal campaign plan that says exactly what should be built or run next to change belief.
A precise no-go theorem if none of the above can be specified cleanly yet.
failure_modes: Restating ADMSR with different wording and no new executable content.
Treating same-family code or extractor diversity as clean-room independence.
Inflating the validation burden into abstract bureaucracy without improving attack coverage.
Sneaking astrophysical law language into a bridge packet.
Calling for more GPU or more ZTARE without a narrower executable target.
